verdict.rationale: Plausible's Stats API keys are scoped to a team (doc-17) and the Stats API itself is read-only (doc-4), giving some coarse-grained least-privilege separation between read (Stats API) and write (Events API) access. However there's no evidence of finer scoping like per-site restriction, expiry, or granular permission levels tailored for agent use. Missing for 10: site-level or resource-level scoping, credential expiration/rotation controls, explicit agent-oriented API key management documentation.
